description: This file defines the main activity for a Tic-Tac-Toe Android application. It manages the game state, user interactions, UI rendering, and game logic including move handling, win/draw detection, and game reset.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing the Tic-Tac-Toe game logic and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, restores saved state, and renders the initial game board.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current game state to support state restoration during configuration changes.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping a game cell, updating game state, checking for winner or draw, and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates UI components to reflect the current game state.

methods.name: renderBoardOnly
methods.description: Updates the game board UI without changing the status text.

methods.name: setBoardEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables interaction with game cells.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines whether the game is a draw (all cells filled with no winner).

methods.name: checkWinner
methods.description: Checks all winning combinations to determine if a player has won.
